title: Professor Chen Wen-Chen Memorial Foundation 陳文成教授紀念基金會
content_html: The Chen Wen-Chen Memorial Foundation was established in memory of Chen Wen-Chen, a Taiwanese national and Carnegie Mellon University professor who was found dead on July 3, 1981, after being held for questioning by Taiwan’s authoritarian government during a visit to his homeland. The foundation was created in the aftermath of his death to honor his legacy and address the political circumstances surrounding it. Its work focuses on promoting social, economic, and political justice as well as human rights for the Taiwanese people. It has served as an important institution within the Taiwanese American community in advocating for democracy and civil liberties in Taiwan.
